intent: Record the testlab rules a requirements patrol changed or added.
observable_outcome: get-context testlab lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The test case list takes a limit from 1 to 101 inclusive and defaults to 51, one row more than a page shows so the client can tell whether another page exists; 0, 102, a non-integer and an empty limit are refused, never replaced by the default.
The test case list takes an offset from 0 to 2147483647 as a plain decimal integer; a negative, fractional, hexadecimal, empty or larger value is refused rather than read as 0.
